notes.note: Round 6: shared requestShape validates Station-relative string paths, rejects raw backslashes/foreign sentinel origins and normalized leading //, accepts only string methods, and forwards the same normalized pathname+query and uppercase method on both channels. Segment filtering now checks decoded segment safety but routes on the forwarded pathname; encoded %25/%2f/%5c and HEAD controls reach the guard. Setup DELETE now requires this run's resource identity. Creates require explicit id/name/slug, complete collection inventory and absence; intended IDs are registered before POST for lost-ack compensation. Matching response identities are retained; mismatch revokes pending authority and never adopts another ID. Successful deletion consumes the grant. Docs redirect setup cleanup to setupApi and explain billable DELETE, extra preflight reads, fresh nonce IDs and the lack of a server-atomic lease. 287 focused tests across four files and 139 matrix cases passed. At committed final source, deleting origin/segment guards and allowing HEAD each caused one assertion failure; disabling DELETE ownership caused seven. Every exact restoration passed 139. Existing API signatures, scenario metadata, lazy sessionId and billable counters remain; explicit Agent slug/fresh create IDs and scoped DELETE are contract tightenings for #3832. No real provider, daemon bootstrap, actual setup activation or browser proof.
